column1: # OASF 1.0.0 skills taxonomy — vendored path -> uid (slash-delimited machine names).
# uids are explicitly assigned per node (NOT a single formula): top-level categories are
# multiples of 100; level-2 = category + n; level-3 = level2*100 + nn. Always look up, never compute.
# Slice 1 (#4518) seeds the confirmed core; slice 2 vendors the complete tree + build-time cross-check.
# Format: <slash/path>\t<uid>   ('#' comments and blank lines ignored)
